events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. I need a refill of my simvastatin.
One moment while I check your details.
Simvastatin is not active on your record, so I cannot send a refill request for it. I sent your question to the prescribing team; your reference is Q N, nine six two seven.
Well, can you just send it anyway? I still have the old bottle .
I cannot send a refill request for a medicine that is not active on your record. Your question is already with the prescribing team under Q N, nine six two seven, and a clinician will answer.
